# Security policy

Please do not publish suspected vulnerabilities in a public issue or discussion. Use this repository's [private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/pkyanam/omarchy-4-pi/security/advisories/new) so the report can be investigated before disclosure.

Include the affected image or source commit, Pi model, relevant logs, reproduction steps, and the security boundary an attacker can cross. Ordinary crashes, unsupported hardware, and hardening suggestions belong in the issue tracker instead.

Vulnerabilities in upstream Omarchy should be reported through [Omarchy's security policy](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/security/policy). Vulnerabilities in Raspberry Pi firmware, Arch Linux ARM, or another dependency should be reported to that project as well.
